sentences.text: Self-determination theory (SDT) is a macro theory of human motivation and personality regarding individuals' innate tendencies toward growth and innate psychological needs.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a macro theory of human motivation and personality regarding individuals' innate tendencies toward growth and innate psychological needs

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Self-determination theory is a macro theory。of 后并列 human motivation 和 personality；regarding 表示“关于”，后接个体的先天成长倾向与先天心理需要，两个 innate 都有“与生俱来”的含义。

sentences.text: It pertains to the motivation behind individuals' choices in the absence of external influences and distractions.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: It 指 SDT，pertain to 表示“涉及、关乎”。behind individuals' choices 说明是哪种动机；in the absence of 表示缺少外部影响与干扰的情形，and 连接 influences 和 distractions。

sentences.text: SDT focuses on the degree to which human behavior is self-motivated and self-determined.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: to which human behavior is self-motivated and self-determined

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 SDT focuses on the degree。to which 引导定语从句修饰 degree，可从 to this degree 理解“达到这种程度”；从句中 self-motivated 和 self-determined 并列描述 human behavior。

sourceSpan.text: SDT focuses on the degree to which human behavior is self-motivated and self-determined.

sentences.text: In the 1970s, research on SDT evolved from studies comparing intrinsic and extrinsic motives and a growing understanding of the dominant role that intrinsic motivation plays in individual behavior.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that intrinsic motivation plays in individual behavior

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 research on SDT evolved from ...。from 后有两个来源：比较内外动机的 studies，以及不断增长的 understanding；comparing 修饰 studies。that 引导修饰 role 的定语从句，对应 intrinsic motivation plays a role。

sentences.text: It was not until the mid-1980s, when Edward L. Deci and Richard Ryan wrote a book entitled Intrinsic Motivation and Self-Determination in Human Behavior, that SDT was formally introduced and recognized as having empirical support.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: when Edward L. Deci and Richard Ryan wrote a book entitled Intrinsic Motivation and Self-Determination in Human Behavior

subordinateClauses.text: that SDT was formally introduced and recognized as having empirical support

sentences.readingHintZh: 这是 It was not until ... that ... 强调结构，表示“直到……才……”。when 引导插入的定语从句，补充20世纪80年代中期发生的事情；它在书名后结束。that 后才是 SDT was introduced and recognized 的核心陈述。

sentences.text: Since the 2000s, research into practical applications of SDT has increased significantly.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: research into practical applications of SDT

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 research into practical applications of SDT，中心词 research 是单数，所以用 has increased。Since the 2000s 给出起点，与现在完成时呼应；significantly 修饰增长幅度。

sentences.text: SDT is rooted in the psychology of intrinsic motivation, drawing upon the complexities of human motivation and the factors that foster or hinder autonomous engagement in activities.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that foster or hinder autonomous engagement in activities

subordinateClauses.text: drawing upon the complexities of human motivation and the factors that foster or hinder autonomous engagement in activities

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 SDT is rooted in ...，表示植根于内在动机心理学。drawing upon ... 是现在分词补充说明；that 修饰 factors，从句中的 foster 与 hinder 共用宾语 autonomous engagement in activities。

sentences.text: Intrinsic motivation refers to initiating an activity because it is interesting and satisfying to do so, as opposed to doing an activity to obtain an external goal (i.e., from extrinsic motivation).
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: because it is interesting and satisfying to do so
as opposed to doing an activity to obtain an external goal (i.e., from extrinsic motivation)

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Intrinsic motivation refers to initiating an activity，refer to 的 to 是介词，后接动名词。because 说明发起活动的原因；it 是形式主语，to do so 指进行该活动。as opposed to 引出对照，to obtain an external goal 是目的不定式。

sentences.text: A taxonomy of motivations has been described based on the degree to which they are internalized.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 A taxonomy of motivations has been described，用现在完成时的被动结构。based on ... 说明分类依据；to which 引导修饰 degree 的定语从句，they 指 motivations，are internalized 表示被内化。

sentences.text: Internalization refers to the active attempt to transform an extrinsic motive into personally endorsed values and thus assimilate behavioral regulations that were originally external.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Internalization refers to the active attempt。to transform ... 说明 attempt 的内容；and 连接 transform 与 assimilate，共享不定式标记 to。that were originally external 是修饰 behavioral regulations 的定语从句。

sentences.text: Deci and Ryan later expanded on their early work, differentiating between intrinsic and extrinsic motivation, and proposed three main intrinsic needs involved in self-determination: autonomy, competence, and relatedness.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: differentiating between intrinsic and extrinsic motivation

sentences.readingHintZh: Deci and Ryan 是并列主语，expanded 与 proposed 是并列谓语。两逗号间的 differentiating ... 是分词补充说明；involved in self-determination 后置修饰 needs，冒号列出三项需要。

sentences.text: According to Deci and Ryan, these three basic psychological needs motivate self-initiated behavior and specify essential nutrients for individual psychological health and well-being.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: According to ... 交代观点来源。主语 these three basic psychological needs 对应 motivate 与 specify 两个并列谓语；self-initiated behavior 是前者宾语，essential nutrients ... 是后者宾语，nutrients 在此是比喻。

sentences.text: These needs are said to be universal and innate.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: These needs 回指三种需要。are said to be ... 表示“据称是／被认为是”，相当于 It is said that these needs are ...；universal 与 innate 是并列表语，分别强调普遍性和先天性。
